mostWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the red cells led to oxygen binding and a useful explanation of reversible haemoglobin binding and release in tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to add red cells to the plasma mixture failed without explaining why; the required sequence was not apparent from the picture descriptions.

surprise.text: The red cells had to bind oxygen before joining the plasma mixture, although the earlier assembly attempt seemed plausible.

arbitrary.text: Adding white cells and platelets to plasma before red cells felt like a game-imposed order rather than an explained biological requirement.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter to see how circulation brings oxygen carriers close to tissues, though this chapter's rigid assembly order was frustrating.
